question: Which shell of the nitrogen atom participates in forming N₂ molecule?
solution:
The correct answer is __**L.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitrogen** atom has **electronic configuration **1s2 2s2 2p3.
 
• The formation of the **N2 molecule involves the sharing of electrons between two nitrogen atoms**.
 
• In the formation of the N2 molecule, the two nitrogen atoms share three pairs of electrons to form a **triple bond.**
